description: This file defines the Controller class for handling user login functionalities in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It manages login display, authentication, token handling, and redirection logic for customer account login processes.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class managing account login procedures, including rendering login page, processing login requests, token generation, and session management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the login page, manages redirection for logged-in users, and displays appropriate error or success messages.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login form submissions, authenticates the customer, manages session data, and handles redirection after login.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Handles login token validation and user authentication via token, sets session data accordingly, and redirects to account or login page.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the current session and customer token are valid and consistent.
